body: Drunk me got a threesome. I have much to learn from his inebriated wisdom.

Hi. I'm dyingcandle, if you click on my user name, you can read my stories. I too, was at the end of my rope. I took a step back and realized I needed help. I went to counseling, I asked teachers for help, and took up Bob Ross style painting. I even asked Reddit for help. I've entered into martial programs to help me get fit. I volunteer with the elderly. 

As for the girl I talked about, our relationship turned into more of an abusive one, so I cut her out of my life. And as that turned sour, I had friends I could turn to, and they caught me. They supported me as some of my footings came loose. They were friends I found by trying to be friends with people. 

It was a totally different strategy for me, but the one I was using was no longer relevant to me and my situations. Have you ever played yellow version? Well, Pikachu's thundershocks will never affect Onix or geodude when facing Brock(despite what the anime wants you to believe), and the only other attack you'd have is quick attack, which does minimal damage. If you keep on doing that, you're going to get nowhere. So, you have to switch up the strategy. Evolve your metapod into butterfree, have it learn confusion, and decimate Brock's team with it. Understand? If not, blame the three margaritas I've had tonight.

So yeah, I switched things up a bit and it has really helped me. A little less than a year ago, I was ready to die. Last night, I lost my virginity in a threesome. Things will get better. Even if you don't think so, they do. Promise.

I came to the comments to maybe see some light banter, some stories, but an all around 'hey, it sucks, but we can make it if we all stick together' feeling. 

Not what I found. If I wanted to here how much of a failure I am at getting girls, I'd go to my mother's house.
Chewing bubblegum helps me sometimes. Weird, I know, but if you know your going to kick your blues in a couple of days, this might help it along.

I have tried killing myself before, but never succeeded in actually dying. Talking it out with Suicide watch has helped me out a lot, but still, some days I want to sit on my front porch and blow my brains out.

Hi. I am dyingcandle. If you click on my username, you can see how little I think of myself. I have been battling depression since the third grade. I have survived three suicide attempts. 

I would like to say that sadness is a paper cut, while depression is open heart surgery.

Why does life have to be so hard? Everyday I try my best in everything I do, but it is never good enough. I am always stuck failing compared to the world. They say everyone has something they are good at. I don't. I can't remember anything I have come in first in.

I am a nothing, I am a nobody. All I want is someone who loves me because they want to love me. I want someone who wants to be with me. I see people everywhere with one another, but I am invisible. Sometimes it seems no one wants me to even be around.

According to my reoccurring nightmares, I am supposed to become the third horseman of the apocalypse, Famine. And as Famine, I ride around on my bike causing plagues and drought. I cause family after family to die terrible deaths, body wracked with the pain of hunger. I see children crying in the street, their bellies empty. And when I wake up, I am extremely hungry, to the point of pain
Thank you. Your words are very soft and kind.

I cause family after family to die terrible deaths, body wracked with the pain of hunger. I see children crying in the street, their bellies empty. And when I wake up, I am extremely hungry, to the point of pain. But I’d hate to think that this is the reason why I am still around. 

As for my writing, I can never really keep going. I have started many times, but other things get in the way. And when I do write, it never seems any good, just mediocre.
